data.exact_reserve_text:
Change in prior year provisions 132,679 43,402 89,277

During 2019 the market experienced loss creep from prior year events such as hurricane Irma (2017) and typhoon Jebi (2018). The most material deterioration coming from typhoon Jebi which materially increased during the first half of 2019 from the reserves set at December 2018. At December 2018 the estimated ultimate insured market loss from typhoon Jebi was estimated to be in the region of $8 billion, by June 2019 this had increased to circa $13 billion.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2019 were 485.327m (USD). During 2019 the syndicate recorded adverse prior year development (gross strengthening) of 132.679m (USD), primarily driven by loss creep on prior natural catastrophe events - most materially Typhoon Jebi (2018) and to a lesser extent Hurricane Irma (2017). The movement reflects deterioration in gross claims provisions (insurance liabilities) before the impact of reinsurance. Some prior-year improvements were noted in Aviation, but overall the prior year movement was a strengthening of reserves.
raw_causal_phrases: loss creep from prior year events such as hurricane Irma (2017) and typhoon Jebi (2018).
The most material deterioration coming from typhoon Jebi which materially increased during the first half of 2019 from the reserves set at December 2018.
There were some improvements in prior year loss events mainly on the Aviation account which did help to negate some of the increases from Irma and Jebi.
In arriving at the level of claims provisions a margin is applied over and above the actuarial best estimate so as to minimise any adverse run-off deviation.

data.data_quality_notes: All amounts are reported in the syndicate's functional/presentational currency (USD). Opening gross claims outstanding and prior year movement are taken from the Technical Provisions reconciliation: opening gross claims = 485,327 (000s), change in prior year provisions = 132,679 (000s) (gross, insurance liabilities column). Exact reserve movement text combines table row and narrative discussing loss creep (Jebi, Irma). No per-LOB quantified prior-year movement was provided, so LOB impacts are inferred from narrative. Claims development triangle present and used as supporting data. Units for triangle are thousands (report shows $'000).
